Parts inventory

The back of the booklet: every part MCSS-Lite ships, with its status. Anything not listed here doesn't exist, and mcss-lite validate rejects it.

  • Stable Changes only in a major version.
  • Beta Shipped and validated; the API may change in a minor version.
  • Deprecated Still works; move to the replacement.

All parts

1 Layouts 8 parts

Layouts
PartNameStatusSinceNotes
l-centerCenterStable0.1.0Centers a block horizontally at reading width without side gutters.
l-clusterClusterStable0.1.0Horizontal group that wraps, with a gap and vertically centered items: button groups, badge lists, tags.
l-containerContainerStable0.1.0Centers page content horizontally with a max width and side gutters.
l-gridGridStable0.1.0Two-dimensional grid with a fixed gap.
l-sectionSectionStable0.1.0Vertical padding for a full-width page section.
l-sidebarSidebarStable0.1.0A sidebar next to main content that stacks when the content would get narrower than 50%.
l-stackStackStable0.1.0Vertical flow: adds space between consecutive children, which keep their own width.
l-switcherSwitcherStable0.1.0Children sit side by side until the container is narrower than a threshold, then all stack at once.

2 Components 12 parts

Components
PartNameStatusSinceNotes
c-alertAlertBeta0.4.0A printed notice on the page: tells people about something that affects what they are doing, with its severity in an icon, a word and a heavier bottom edge.
c-badgeBadgeStable0.1.0A short, non-interactive label for status or category, such as "Beta" or "Paid".
c-buttonButtonStable0.1.0Triggers an action.
c-cardCardStable0.1.0A raised surface that groups related content, such as a summary, a settings group or a list item.
c-checkboxCheckboxBeta0.4.0A native checkbox with its label: pick any number of options, or confirm one statement.
c-form-fieldForm fieldStable0.1.0Wraps one form control with its label, help text and error message.
c-iconIconBeta0.4.0A line icon from the MCSS-Lite sprite, drawn with a 2px stroke in the current text color.
c-inputInputStable0.1.0Single-line text entry.
c-labelLabelDeprecated0.1.0Use c-form-field__label
c-modalModalStable0.1.0A dialog over the page that blocks interaction until dismissed.
c-radioRadioBeta0.4.0A native radio button with its label: pick exactly one option from a short, visible list.
c-toggleToggleBeta0.4.0An on/off switch built on a native checkbox with role="switch": the setting applies as soon as it changes.
